uses: local fallback OTP and reset mail

scheduled_jobs.name: expire-login-codes
scheduled_jobs.purpose: mark stale local fallback login codes and reset tokens unusable

scheduled_jobs.name: stale-match-reminders
scheduled_jobs.purpose: queue client reminders for pending mini bids older than 24 hours

scheduled_jobs.name: moderation-digest
scheduled_jobs.purpose: email admins a weekday report queue summary

domain_rules: Mount Clerk sign-in on /login and /start; do not redirect users to hosted Clerk pages.
Proxy Clerk Frontend API traffic through https://workdoe.com/__clerk when using the Workdoe Worker.
Store Clerk user IDs in users.external_subject with users.auth_provider = 'clerk'.
Use Clerk webhooks to sync email, suspension, and deletion state into D1.

required_env.CLERK_JWT_KEY: set as a secret for networkless verification
required_env.CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: set as a secret or public deployment env

name: workdoe
privacy_invariants: Only approximate city/ZIP map pins are public before a match is approved.
Job and contractor photos stay private behind role and match checks.
Exact client contact details are not exposed on the public lead board.
Client, contractor, and admin role data stays compartmentalized.
Authentication can be delegated to Clerk, but Workdoe remains the source of truth for roles, job permissions, moderation, and match visibility.
